<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.thatlayover.life/countries/{{wf {"path":"slug","type":"PlainText"} }}">
<style id="tll-country-filed-v1">.tllcx-filed-eyebrow{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}.tllcx-filed-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:800}.tllcx-filed-card:hover{outline:2px solid #00C9C8;outline-offset:2px}</style>
<style id="tll-country-filed-v2">
#tllcf-layovers,#tllcf-races,#tllcf-diary{display:none}
#tllcf-layovers .w-dyn-items,#tllcf-races .w-dyn-items,#tllcf-diary .w-dyn-items{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:16px;margin:16px 0 0 0;align-items:stretch}
#tllcf-layovers .w-dyn-item,#tllcf-races .w-dyn-item,#tllcf-diary .w-dyn-item{display:flex}
.tllcf-cflag{display:none!important}
.tllcf-kicker{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace!important}
.tllcf-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif!important;font-weight:800!important}
.tllcf-dek,.tllcf-more{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',system-ui,sans-serif!important}
.tllcf-more{margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px}
.tllcf-card .w-dyn-bind-empty{display:none}
#tllcf-layovers .w-dyn-empty,#tllcf-races .w-dyn-empty,#tllcf-diary .w-dyn-empty{display:none}
@media (max-width:600px){#tllcf-layovers .w-dyn-items,#tllcf-races .w-dyn-items,#tllcf-diary .w-dyn-items{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<style id="tll-cx-expats-v1">
[data-tll-cx-expats]{background:#FDF9F3;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE;padding:56px 0 48px}
[data-tll-cx-wrap]{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(280px,1fr);gap:36px}
[data-tll-cx-eyebrow]{font:600 11.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#067A79;margin-bottom:10px}
[data-tll-cx-h2]{font:800 clamp(28px,4vw,42px)/1.05 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:0 0 12px;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-cx-h2] em{font-style:italic;color:#C8325B}
[data-tll-cx-counts]{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 18px}
[data-tll-cx-counts] span{font:600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #c9b89a;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 11px;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-cx-grid]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:16px}
[data-tll-cx-empty][hidden],[data-tll-cx-join][hidden]{display:none}
[data-tll-cx-empty]{border:1.5px dashed #c9b89a;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
[data-tll-cx-empty] p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-cx-empty] a,[data-tll-cx-suggest]{font:600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#C8325B;text-decoration:none}
[data-tll-cx-join]{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#6B6660}
[data-tll-cx-join] a{color:#C8325B;font-weight:600}
[data-tll-cx-res]{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] a{display:block;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] a:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] .n{font:800 15px/1.2 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] .t{font:600 9.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #c9b89a;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;color:#6B6660;white-space:nowrap}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] .d{font-size:13px;color:#6B6660;margin:4px 0 0;line-height:1.4}
[data-tll-cx-reslist] .h{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#067A79;margin-top:6px}
[data-tll-cx-resnote]{font-size:12px;color:#6B6660;margin:14px 0 8px}
[data-tll-cx-groups]:empty{display:none}
[data-tll-cx-src]{display:none}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-card{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-avatar{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 17px 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;overflow:hidden;flex:none}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-name{font:800 18px/1.15 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:0}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-name a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-sub{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:#6B6660;line-height:1.4}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-tag{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #c9b89a;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 9px;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-badge{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 9.5px 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;text-decoration:none;background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-badge--ig{background:#F0507A;color:#fff}[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-badge--tt{background:#0A0B14;color:#00C9C8}[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-badge--yt{background:#C8425E;color:#fff}[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-badge--ss{background:#D98A2B;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-contact{margin-left:auto;font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#067A79;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #067A79;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px}
[data-tll-cx-expats] .tlldir-report{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660;text-decoration:none}
@media (max-width:860px){[data-tll-cx-wrap]{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
